description: Directed a team to develop a computer vision pipeline for Colgate’s shelf monitoring, reducing manual audits by 60% across retail sites.
Improved detection accuracy for similar-packaged goods by fine-tuning YOLOv5 on 500+ SKUs, achieving 95% precision in varied store layouts.
Built an OpenCV dimension-based algorithm to distinguish products by millimeter specs, increasing classification reliability by 15%.
Accelerated inference with Python multiprocessing, boosting production efficiency by 50%.
Adapted the same framework for Dabur’s global lineup, preparing scalable models for 300+ SKU expansion.
Streamlined sanctions data ingestion for OCR-INC, coordinating a 3-person team to parse feeds from 6 sources via AWS Lambda and EC2/S3, removing 95% of duplicates through hash-based deduplication.
Automated product counting for HRI’s Streax range, processing 10 000+ images per month using SAM and DinoV2 segmentation, reducing manual checks by 90%.
Verified Colgate field captures using GPS-based clustering, correcting 20% coordinate mismatches and ensuring 98% geofencing compliance.
Delivered a generative-AI prototype for Kellogg’s ad campaigns, integrating FAISS embeddings and PSD-layer parsing to accelerate creative replacement by 40% while conserving browser resources.
Tackled sparse credit data by designing an alternative scoring engine using device metadata, increasing approval accuracy by 25% for non-traditional applicants.
Streamlined KYC data capture through a React Native app integrating Axios for secure transmission, minimizing errors by 20%.
Implemented OCR verification for identity documents with OpenCV, reaching 90% accuracy and condensing processing from minutes to seconds.
Enhanced video-KYC fraud detection through liveness checks, improving compliance by 35%.
Processed unstructured SMS data with an NLP multi-class classifier in spaCy, reaching 92% accuracy in categorizing transactions and spam.
Created a custom NER system to extract financial details (e.g., amounts, dates), speeding up transaction insights.
Implemented GDPR-compliant data handling (PII separation, hashing, encryption), ensuring 100% secure storage and preventing potential privacy breaches.
Resolved a QR code generation flaw with a progressive save system, improving data integrity by 40% and meeting MVP stability within two weeks.
Designed a full-stack architecture (Express.js + MongoDB) with zero downtime, handling 50+ daily operations for the Climate Conversations Initiative.
Performed QA and post-deployment testing, fixing 15 bugs and achieving 99% uptime.
Developed installable Windows monitoring software and automated four scheduled scripts with precise timing logic, simplifying deployment.
Collaborated within a three-person team on design reviews and feature releases, ensuring reliable, on-time deliveries.
